unresolvedTrails: marinenav: Use Panmure Island, Prince Edward Island as the current official operating and manufacturing location; do not propagate unrelated Youngs Cove or Nova Scotia location noise, and keep product performance and named deployment claims source-attributed.

maritime-launch-services: Maritime Launch Services remains a development-stage spaceport operator; planned launches, cadence, certification and customer activity must not be represented as completed operational launch capability.
mathers-logistics: The public source establishes defence-logistics growth and heavy-lift investment but does not identify a specific CAF customer, logistics operation or cargo type.

mda-space: CHORUS late-2026 launch timing and planned service are forward-looking; do not describe the constellation as active service before an independently confirmed launch and commissioning milestone.

mds-aero-support: Official sources support engine-test facilities and lifecycle services, but exact active customer programs, security boundaries, certification scope and current delivery capacity remain configuration-specific.

mhi-rj-aviation-group: MHI RJ Aviation Group is a Canadian ULC wholly owned by Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries; do not describe it as Canadian-owned or transfer parent-company work to the Canadian operating entity without evidence.
microlynx-systems: The government source describes the RDII project scope; this candidate does not infer installation status, operational readiness, or NORAD deployment beyond that public project.

milaero-electronics-atlantic: MilAero's public material supports its stated aerospace and defence market and controlled-goods posture, but this candidate does not attribute a specific military platform or contract.

mindbridge: MindBridge provides financial and audit risk analytics; any defence relevance is an enabling governance or assurance assessment, not evidence of operational intelligence, targeting or mission-analysis capability.
minesense: MineSense supports ore-grade control and strategic-minerals supply chains; defence relevance is indirect and does not make its mining sensors a deployed defence capability.

mission-control: Public evidence supports the bounded operating profile for Mission Control, but customer, procurement, deployment and ownership conclusions remain limited to what the cited sources explicitly establish.

modest-tree: RENK's disclosed interest in Modest Tree is a 28.89 percent minority stake, not a controlling subsidiary relationship; preserve the ownership boundary and keep adoption claims source-attributed.

mosaic-manufacturing: Exact legal identity, ownership and current Canadian production site remain unresolved; keep unsupported corporate fields nullable and distinguish marketed additive-manufacturing capability from independently proven defence delivery.

mpb-communications: The StarBurst source surfaces conflicting June 29 and July 26, 2026 dates; do not qualify that development or set current-activity timing until the issuer chronology is reconciled.
mro-electronic-supply: The candidate preserves public manufacturing and funding information and does not infer a contract, customer or end platform from the named expansion project.

nautel-sonar: Nautel Sonar is an operating brand and CanadaBuys names NAUTEL C-TECH LIMITED as a legal supplier; do not equate it automatically with Nautel Limited or imply current naval deployment without exact entity and contract evidence.

navamar: A 2025 Quebec layoff notice creates current capacity uncertainty but is not closure evidence. The final sea-to-shore connector was delivered March 21, 2024, so do not preserve a stale incomplete-delivery caveat.

navitas-vehicle-systems: Current first-party materials conflict between Navitas Vehicle Systems Inc. and Ltd.; preserve the existing legal name or mark it unresolved, and do not treat low-speed or industrial vehicle components as a named defence delivery.

newdock: The 2026 ACOA award funds design and expansion work, not completed infrastructure; preserve the Membertou, Qalipu and Horizon ownership partnership and do not infer the undisclosed equity split.

niricson: The NRC contribution supports dual-use airfield-pavement mapping R&D; product accuracy, false-positive rates, deployment scale and current Canadian staffing remain unverified beyond cited sources.

nord-quantique: Use nordquantique.com as the current canonical domain. July 2026 SPAM performance and roadmap claims are company-reported R&D evidence, not independently validated or commercially deployable quantum capability.

nordspace: No successful orbital launch was found; Taiga was reported ready and awaiting a launch window. Conditional Launch the North support is Phase 1 development funding, not procurement, delivery or operational launch service.

norsat-international: Norsat International Inc. is a Canadian subsidiary of Hytera Communications Co. Ltd., with Sinclair inside the Norsat group; disclose foreign-parent ownership and do not infer procurement eligibility or ineligibility.
nortac-defence: Sovereign and source-code claims are vendor-attributed, and old public contracts do not prove current operational use, customer status or deployment.
north-vector-dynamics: Sovereign and full-spectrum missile language is vendor positioning; distinguish funded development and prototypes from qualified, delivered or operational capability.

northstar-earth-space: The April 2026 SPAC transaction was proposed, not confirmed closed. Attribute the reported greater-than-CAD40-million RCAF services value to the company; CanadaBuys confirms a standing-offer vehicle but not that value.

novafuse: The CanadaBuys item records supplier interest in partnering and IDEaS items remain under evaluation; none is an award, customer, deployment or independent performance validation, and all product metrics remain vendor-attributed.
nv-piping-systems: FedDev identifies defence as a prospective market for expanded capacity; it does not establish a named defence or naval delivery, product qualification or active customer.
objexis: Use OBJEXIS AI Inc. as the legal identity. The DND Urban CUAS Sandbox prize supports evaluated trial performance, not field adoption, procurement or operational deployment.

obruta-space-solutions: NASA Astrobee evidence supports a flight-software demonstration, not full rendezvous, proximity-operations and docking hardware qualification, operational adoption or commercial readiness.

ocean-sonics: Official sources support digital hydrophones and current software, but DFO procurement is civilian and does not establish military qualification or adoption; product specifications remain vendor-published.

open-ocean-robotics: A British Columbia port pilot and Innovative Solutions Canada additional-sales eligibility are not CAF adoption or contract evidence; endurance, sensor performance, communications and production scale remain mission-specific.

orbital-research: Canadian Space Agency projects establish development activity and stated readiness targets, not operational use, flight qualification or production delivery; space-rated claims remain configuration-specific.

orthogone-technologies: Orthogone provides engineering and productization services; do not imply it owns, manufactures or has deployed every client system, and named customers, security certifications and production capacity remain unresolved.

osi-maritime-systems: Current customer contracts support navigation and bridge-system work, but fleet counts are vendor-reported and public sources do not disclose exact values, configurations, cyber accreditation or production capacity.

ottawa-infotainment: A preview, demonstration or partner selection does not establish production availability or deployment; environmental qualification, cyber certification and the claimed Canadian supply-chain boundary remain unresolved.

pacific-geomatics: Pacific Geomatics brokers and integrates access to third-party imagery; it is not a satellite manufacturer or operator, and current procurement ceilings, tasking terms, data residency and government users remain unresolved.

pal-aerospace: The CAD750-million CT-142Q agreement was reported concluded July 15, 2026, superseding the stale pending-contract caveat; preserve exact PAL, SkyAlyne and affiliate workshare boundaries.

peraso: Peraso Inc. is a Delaware Nasdaq issuer headquartered in San Jose with Canadian operating and R&D facilities; do not describe the group as Canadian-owned or Toronto-headquartered, and military IFF shipments do not establish broader adoption.

perceptive-space-systems: NRC records Oakville while the company describes a remote-first, Toronto-anchored operation; preserve that location nuance, and do not treat unnamed pilots or vendor quality claims as defence deployment evidence.

photon-etc: Photon etc.'s current portfolio is primarily laboratory and industrial; ISR and defence fit remain derived, and public sources do not establish ruggedization, export status, defence customers or field deployment.
photon-iv: O-RAN PlugFest participation and a handover demonstration are not certification or production deployment; uptime, latency and encryption claims require independent support.

photonic: Financing, valuation and roadmap statements do not establish deployable fault-tolerant quantum capability; distinguish Vancouver headquarters from the Coquitlam government-project site and preserve commercialization unknowns.

picovoice: Use a Vancouver and British Columbia Canadian footprint rather than the unsupported historical Montreal location; performance superlatives and customer stories remain first-party, with no public defence deployment or security certification.

pleora-technologies: Published alignment with VIVOE, NGVA, GVA or VICTORY requirements is not formal certification; named defence deployments, cyber hardening and configuration-specific qualification remain unknown.

prandtl-dynamics: DND evidence supports detection, confirmation and location performance in a sandbox; vendor claims of disruption or disablement require separate evidence and must not be presented as government-validated.

pro-dive-marine-services: The exact legal name, certification currency, current ROV configurations and named active contracts remain unresolved; historical client lists and ROV copy may not represent current relationships.

prosaris-solutions: Defence and shipboard relevance is a derived sustainment use case; no named current defence customer or deployment is public, and performance, hazardous-area status and manufacturing scale remain unresolved.

Mecanica Scientific Services: The canonical True North Map record is a false identity and capability match. Current durable evidence identifies Mecanica as a United States forensic and accident-reconstruction business associated with Oxnard, California, while no Canadian maritime or naval engineering footprint was found.

Picomole: The canonical True North Map record is a false identity and capability match. Picomole Inc. was a Moncton breath-analysis medical-device company renamed Breathe BioMedical Inc.; the old domain redirects to Breathe BioMedical, not an Ottawa cybersecurity or attack-surface company.
